body:
Ports reflex-dev/reflex#6597 (ENG-9668) into reflex-enterprise, per the review suggestion there.

`rxe.google_font(family, *, weights=(400,), italic=False, display="swap")` returns the `preconnect` hints and a `display=swap` stylesheet `<link>` for a Google Font. Pass them to `head_components`, so the browser fetches the font during the initial HTML parse instead of behind the global stylesheet's `@import` chain.

```python
app = rxe.App(head_components=rxe.google_font("Inter", weights=[400, 700]))
```

## Changes
- `reflex_enterprise/fonts.py`: `google_font`, exported as `rxe.google_font` (stub regenerated). An empty `weights` raises `ValueError`.
- `tests/units/test_fonts.py`: the tests from the framework PR, plus an empty-weights test.
- `docs/fonts.md`: Google Fonts, other providers, and local font preloading.
- News fragment.

## Not ported
The framework PR also added an `as_` prop to `el.Link` for `rel="preload"`. This PR works with the published framework without it: the docs pass `as` through `custom_attrs={"as": "font"}`, and a test checks that it renders.

## Tests
- `ruff check`, `ruff format`, `pyright`: clean
- `pytest tests/units`: 1154 passed
title: feat: add rxe.google_font for faster font loading from the document head
